behavior.allowed: Exact raw present=1 query on an already allowlisted item whose actual file suffix is .html; GET and HEAD, including the root edition alias.
behavior.rejected: Unknown or extra query parameters, encoded query variants, presentation queries on media/JSON, unknown or private routes, literal fragments, traversal, bad Host, changed file identity and symlink substitution.
behavior.unchanged: No-query HTML/media and Range handling; initial hash binding and secure_open path guards.

tests.fixture_scope: Temporary synthetic files and ephemeral loopback HTTP server only. No existing preview process, UI, cloud, authentication or live demo data touched.

read_only_review.scope: Inspected exact query condition and focused HTTP tests; existing descriptor walk, startup digest, per-request identity and range handling remain shared.
